description: LSM compactor retains deletion tombstones during bottom-tier (max_level) merges, leaking storage space indefinitely.
spec_notes: CompactionEngine.merge_sstables must filter out (k, None) tombstones when target_level >= max_level.

repo_files.lsm_engine.py:
"""High level LSM storage engine."""

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from compactor import CompactionEngine
from sstable import SSTable


class LSMStorageEngine:
    def __init__(self, max_level: int = 2):
        self.compactor = CompactionEngine(max_level=max_level)
        self.levels: Dict[int, List[SSTable]] = {lvl: [] for lvl in range(max_level + 1)}

    def compact_level(self, level: int, out_id: str) -> SSTable:
        tables = self.levels.get(level, [])
        target_lvl = min(self.compactor.max_level, level + 1)
        merged = self.compactor.merge_sstables(target_lvl, tables, out_id)
        self.levels[level] = []
        self.levels[target_lvl].append(merged)
        return merged

tests.test_lsm_compaction.py:
from sstable import SSTable
from compactor import CompactionEngine
from lsm_engine import LSMStorageEngine


def test_basic_sst_merge_overwrites():
    engine = CompactionEngine(max_level=2)
    t1 = SSTable("t1", 0, [("a", 1), ("b", 2)])
    t2 = SSTable("t2", 0, [("b", 20), ("c", 3)])
    merged = engine.merge_sstables(1, [t1, t2], "m1")
    assert merged.entries == [("a", 1), ("b", 20), ("c", 3)]


def test_bottom_level_compaction_purges_tombstones():
    engine = CompactionEngine(max_level=2)
    t1 = SSTable("t1", 1, [("user_1", "Alice"), ("user_2", "Bob")])
    t2 = SSTable("t2", 1, [("user_1", None)])  # Deletion tombstone for user_1
    # Compacting into max_level=2 must PURGE user_1 tombstone!
    merged = engine.merge_sstables(2, [t1, t2], "m_final")
    assert merged.entries == [("user_2", "Bob")]
    assert not any(k == "user_1" for k, v in merged.entries)


def test_intermediate_level_preserves_tombstones():
    engine = CompactionEngine(max_level=3)
    t1 = SSTable("t1", 0, [("x", "val")])
    t2 = SSTable("t2", 0, [("x", None)])
    # Compacting into intermediate level 1 must preserve tombstone for lower levels
    merged = engine.merge_sstables(1, [t1, t2], "m_inter")
    assert merged.entries == [("x", None)]
